summary: *NERFING TOOLBOXES* Currently toolboxes are containers AND weapons...

comments.content:
As we talked about in chat:

Normal and Electrical Toolboxes are very inconspicuous to carry around, the
best weapon in the game. 

Whoever isn't really paranoid if someone is standing next to them with a
toolbox usually winds up on the ground soon after.

Solution:

Something along the lines crowbars very good, and introduce lead pipes as
little better (and a lot more KO chance to the head/body).
Neither should be concealable in any way.

Crowbars you use to repair stuff, open firelocks, or cause lots of trouble,
so it's a big giveaway if someone has one.

Lead pipes pretty much mean they want to bash your face in... or build a
pipe section.

Toolboxes could be used as a coup de grace weapon? How about making it so
that when you use a toolbox on a person, it's a 2 or 3-second action that
really hurts them. Think of it like a reverse-CPR.

We don't need lead pipes.
Goons are classier than that, as back in ye olden days.


If later it becomes an issue, add pipes. But for now, it's fine.
